text.p: Core Ventures Inc said Monday it had entered into talks to acquire a company and planned to make a definitive announcement with "the next several days" about a potential deal.

Core said in a statement it was discussing buying a company that had developed a patented fingerprint identification and verification system. It said the system usea a patented computer software program to electronically scan and interpret fingerprints.
"It is the intent of Core Ventures to take a leadership position in the fast-growing identification industry," it said.
"The negotiations are at a stage that a more definitive announcement will be made within the next several days," it said.
